thread:
maria: quick heads-up — I opened a PR to update the tracing-hook examples used in the cost/latency breakdown doc. the old snippet used sample_rate=0.1 and didn't show weighted attribution, so folks might misinterpret per-span cost. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

alex: skimming now. is this the change that moves from trace.sample(...) to trace.start_span(...)?

maria: yeah — moved to the new hook API. example now shows Node + Python variants and a tiny table that explains how weighted sampling affects billed tokens.

kevin: can we add a short note about renaming the metric from "inference_latency_ms" to "llm.inference.latency_ms"? ops expects the latter for dashboards.

maria: good call. i'll update snippet and the dashboard example to reflect the new metric.

linda: I noticed one lint failure in the Node snippet: backticks around the import line are missing, causing the code block to render inline. i'll open a tiny commit to fix formatting.

kevin: also, let's include this code comment in the snippet: `// sampling weight = token_count * model_cost_factor` — makes it explicit how we calculate attribution.

maria: added that in a follow-up commit. here are the two snippets included in the PR:

```js
// Node tracing hook (new API)
const span = trace.start_span('llm.generation', { sampling_weight: tokens.length * modelCostFactor });
await model.generate(...);
span.end();
```

```py
# Python tracing hook (new API)
with tracer.start_span('llm.generation', sampling_weight=tokens_len * model_cost_factor) as span:
    outputs = model.generate(...)
```

alex: small question — what default sampling_weight should we recommend if customers don't compute token counts? 1?

kevin: defaulting to 1 is fine, but we should call out that it will under-attribute cost for long outputs. put that as a callout.

maria: will do. i've added a "Recommended defaults" row in the snippet table: default=1, heuristic=token_count, recommended=token_count for production.

sre-ops: FYI production latency varies a lot by model and sequence length. please add a short caveat in the latency section: "observed latencies are sample medians from our benchmark cluster; your numbers will vary with model, length, and batching."

maria: added that caveat and linked to our benchmark dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/benchmarks/latency-by-model

docs-bot: Preview build passed — https://deploy-preview-842--redwood-docs.netlify.app/observability/tracing-costs (checks: lint, spellcheck, mdx) :white_check_mark:

linda: tiny nit — in the Python snippet the placeholder `tokens_len` should be `tokens_len = len(tokens)` earlier or use `len(tokens)` inline. suggest the latter for clarity.

maria: replaced with `len(tokens)` inline.

alex: LGTM from me aside from one wording nit on the table header ("Sampling default" -> "Default sampling weight").

kevin: i'll do a quick pass on the dashboard JSON to ensure the metric rename lands everywhere.

maria: thanks — i'll wait for kevin's dashboard patch. once that's in, i'll merge the docs PR. planning to merge after CI stays green for 30m. anyone else need to add examples (rust, go)?

kevin: maybe a short Rust snippet would be helpful for platform teams, but it's not blocking. we can add in a followup.

maria: merging in ~30 if no blockers. tagging @alex for final approve. :eyes:

alex: approved — go ahead. :thumbsup:

maria: merged. thanks everyone. i'll follow up with a small issue to add Rust/Go snippets and a link-check for dashboards.

docs-bot: CI deploy succeeded — live at https://docs.redwood.ai/observability/tracing-costs :tada:
